name: Daily Standup Report Generator
description: Automates daily standup report creation by fetching PR status, issue progress, and commit activity directly from GitHub via OAuth - generates formatted reports stored in ./standup/ folder for team communication and historical tracking

environment_variables.name: INCLUDE_PRS
environment_variables.description: Include PR status in the report (true/false)

environment_variables.name: INCLUDE_ISSUES
environment_variables.description: Include issue progress in the report (true/false)

environment_variables.name: TEAM_CHANNEL
environment_variables.description: Team channel name to mention in the report (e.g., '#engineering')
